# Puravigal

> Puravigal builds practical business software for micro and small businesses, starting with Puravigal POS.

## Products
- Puravigal POS: billing, sales and inventory software for small retail shops, cafés, restaurants and similar micro businesses.
- CRM: planned product for customer relationships and follow-ups.
- ERP: planned product for connected business operations.

## Audience
Micro businesses, small retail shops, cafés, restaurants, bakeries and other everyday businesses.
